items.why: Semiconductor stocks sold off as the hot CPI report spooked rate-sensitive AI chip names; the SOXX index fell for a seventh straight day.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape. Big tech fell as the hot inflation print revived fears of higher for longer rates.
Slid with the chip sector on the hot inflation data, with AI hardware names pressured across the board.
Spiked as stocks posted their worst session since July after the hot CPI report stoked fears of delayed Fed rate cuts.

market_note: Futures pointed to lingering weakness after the close as markets digested the inflation data.
summary: A hotter than expected inflation reading slammed stocks to their worst day since July. Tech and chipmakers led the selloff as traders worried the Fed could hold off on rate cuts, while the VIX jumped more than 10 percent.
